verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own MFA capability for app users ([appwrite-docs-4]), which covers part of the story. The only federated login evidence is 30+ social OAuth providers like GitHub, Google and Apple ([appwrite-docs-1], [appwrite-docs-45]); that is consumer social login, not enterprise SAML/OIDC SSO, so it earns no credit for the SSO half. missing for 10: enterprise SAML or generic OIDC SSO support, ability to enforce or require MFA for all users, in-depth MFA documentation, independent corroboration.
